system.description:
11th Level Clan Feature

Uchiha’s affinity to fire release isn’t just associated with offensive fire release, but in how they move, fight and counter. Their passion burns bright, igniting the embers of ambition in all others. When you activate your Sharingan, you can select 2 of the listed abilities, gaining them for the duration of this combat. You can use your selected abilities, once per turn. You cannot use more than one of these abilities as part of the same trigger;

Blazing Set Up. Once per turn, when you deal damage to a creature with an attack or jutsu you cast of B-Rank or lower, you can spend 1 Ocular Charge or your Bonus action to mark all affected creatures until the end of your next turn. The next time a marked creature takes damage from yourself or one of your allies that you can see, you can detonate the mark, dealing 3d6 fire damage to the marked creature.

After-Image Assault. Once per turn, when you deal damage to a hostile creature, you can spend 1 Ocular Charge or your reaction to force them to make a Wisdom saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, until the start of your next turn, attacks against you from the affected creature is at disadvantage. If the affected creature deals damage to you through this effect, you can choose to select a space within 10 feet of yourself, and teleport to that space as you try to create distance between yourself and the enemy.

Ricochet Technique. Once per turn, when you make a ranged attack, you can spend 1 Ocular Charge or 1 Bonus action to select a second creature within 20-feet of the original target. Remake your attack roll, targeting the second creature. On a hit, you deal half damage to the second target but apply the original attacks effects to the second target as well.

Critical Refocus. Once per turn, when a creature critically fails their saving throw resisting a Genjutsu you cast, you regain 1 Ocular Charge, per creature that critically failed.

Commanding Gaze. Once per turn, in place of an attack granted by the Attack action, you can gaze into the eyes of a non-blinded enemy you can see within 30 feet of you. When you do, you can spend 1 Ocular Charge and they make a Wisdom or Intelligence saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failed save, you can imprint one of the following subconscious commands into them. Once you use this ability, you cannot do so again until the end of your next turn.

Command, Disarm. The affected creature, at the beginning or end of their turn, your choice, throws their weapon 30 + 5 times their strength of dexterity modifier in feet away from themselves in a direct of your choice.

Command, Retarget. When the affected creature targets a creature it can see, it must target a different creature it can see, even if that creature is its own ally.

Command, Telegraph. The affected creature telegraphs their next attack or jutsu unconsciously yelling out its name and its effects and who they are targeting and why. You and all allied creatures that can see and hear them gains the benefit of a successful Read the Enemy.

Command, Taunt. The affected creature gains disadvantage on attacks targeting creatures other than yourself. Additionally, creatures other than yourself treat the affected creatures save DC as -2 lower unless you are part of the area of effect or making the same saving throw from the same effect.
